method: user-approved modeled capacity result from approved-image native renderer measurements
limitations: The sample invokes the production renderer image and darktable command, but not SQS, S3, API callback, task start, or queue-scaling overhead.
Cache-hit latency and uncached request-start latency require a deployed HTTP/API fixture and are not asserted by this model.
The configured non-production renderer service has one active single-concurrency task; it cannot satisfy the modeled 100000-image freshness target.
